title: Git Tutorial
description: Learn Git step-by-step, from installation to version control with commits, branches, merges, and remote repositories. Includes interactive exercises and practical examples for each topic.

content.content: Install Git
Git can be installed from https://git-scm.com/downloads

content: Download the installer for your OS
Run the installer and follow the instructions

content.content: Set up Git
Configure your Git username and email to track your commits.

git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "you@example.com"

questions.question: Set your Git username to 'Alice' and email to 'alice@example.com'

content.content: Create a Repository
Initialize a Git repository in your project folder to start version controlling.

git init
git status

questions.question: Initialize a new Git repository in the current folder

content.content: Stage and Commit Changes
Use `git add` to stage files and `git commit` to save changes.

git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
git log

questions.question: Add all files and commit with message 'First commit'

content.content: Working with Branches
Branches allow you to work on features independently.

git branch feature-1
git checkout feature-1
git branch

questions.question: Create and switch to a branch named 'feature-1'

content.content: Merging Branches
Merge branches to integrate features into main branch.

git checkout main
git merge feature-1
Connecting to Remote
Connect your local repository to a remote GitHub repository.

git remote add origin https://github.com/user/repo.git
git push -u origin main

questions.question: Add a remote named 'origin' and push the main branch

content.content: Updating Local Repository
Use `git fetch` to get updates and `git pull` to merge changes from remote.

git fetch origin
git pull origin main

questions.question: Fetch and pull changes from remote 'origin'

content.content: .gitignore File
Use .gitignore to exclude files from being tracked by Git.

node_modules/
.env
.DS_Store
